column2: [intro]
I woke up this morning with a heavy heart,
But as soon as I grabbed my spatula, I found a fresh start.
I pulled out my pans, my pots with a clatter,
In my kitchen, I found my matter.
When my smile is feeling low,
I don my hat and take it on the go.
Cooking’s good for the soul, you see,
It lifts my spirits and sets my worries free.
I decided to whip up a grand feast,
A mix of flavors, a divine release.
Paprika in my pumpkin soup so bright,
And chili in my dauphinois delight.
When my smile is feeling low,
I don my hat and take it on the go.
Cooking’s good for the soul, you see,
It lifts my spirits and sets my worries free.
